description: Guardian Android-first implementation tracks. Each ready task has disjoint exact file scope and a code-owned fixed test profile.

tasks.title: Reproduce Library file not found only if it recurs
tasks.scope: The user confirmed on 2026-11-21 that Library file not found has not recurred. Repository inspection and APK packaging checks already confirm shared/filter_rules.txt is packaged; PR #231 addresses bounded startup diagnostics. Do not repeat static investigation or make speculative changes. Resume only if a new physical-device occurrence is reproduced with a contemporaneous sanitized diagnostic bundle. Then trace MainActivity.requestProtection through GuardianVpnService and the exact APK asset/native-library lookup; change only defects supported by that evidence. Never mark a physical-device failure resolved without its diagnostic bundle.
acceptance_criteria: Do not perform duplicate static investigation while the failure is not recurring.
If a new occurrence is captured, identify the exact failing asset/native-library/runtime operation from its diagnostic bundle.
Private messages, paths, URLs and credentials never enter the support report.
Regression tests cover any evidence-based changed behavior.
No physical-device issue is marked resolved without a device diagnostic bundle.

tasks.title: Harden the filter redistribution approval gate
tasks.scope: Review the existing production redistribution approval verifier and its tests. Improve fail-closed validation for malformed or ambiguous approval records only. Never approve a source, invent a legal decision, or weaken existing release gating.
acceptance_criteria: An empty source list, missing license identifier, duplicate source ID or missing approval reference remains blocked.
Only explicitly approved and traceably referenced records can pass the contract test.
Example upstream filter sources remain unapproved; no live source approval is fabricated.

tasks.title: Strengthen Android production signing and distribution policy
tasks.scope: Review the Android Gradle release configuration and distribution build-type policy tests. Improve validation or regression coverage without supplying production secrets, changing signer identity, inventing HTTPS endpoints, or making Release builds succeed when required production configuration is missing.
acceptance_criteria: Release and direct-install variants remain blocked without the real production keystore and required HTTPS service configuration.
Google Play and direct-install permission/updater boundaries remain distinct.
No secret, private key, keystore or fabricated production endpoint is added.
Android unit tests and lint pass.
